results.title: Annie Andrews, Darline Graham set for debate in South Carolina U.S. Senate race
results.description: South Carolina U.S. Senator Darline Graham says she’s ‘in’ for an Oct. 11 debate with Annie Andrews, while Andrews is pushing for more televised showdowns.

results.title: Zero female Labour MPs reply to women over male migrant camp - 'We shouldn't have to beg'
results.description: EXCLUSIVE: A campaign group, the Women of Piddington, wrote to female MPs with a plea for support over Home Office plans to dump 1,250 male migrants on their doorstep.
